verdict.rationale: Drata's API v2 reference lists first-party endpoints for each element of the story: Create Custom Framework and Create/Update Framework Requirements, Create/Modify Control with requirement mappings, Create Custom Monitoring Test, and Create/Update Evidence Library Item. These sit alongside the List Frameworks, Controls and Tests endpoints that expose the built-in content. Missing for 10: the evidence is only endpoint titles, with no detail on how custom tests are defined or how evidence requirements attach to custom controls; no UI-level documentation of the custom framework/control workflow; and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
